name: AI Consensus Assessment Initiative Questionnaire
description: AI-specific vendor self-assessment questionnaire derived from AICM v1.1.0. 320 yes/no questions across all 247 AICM controls, every control carrying at least one question. AI-CAIQ is to AICM as CAIQ is to CCM — the vendor-attestation form of the controls framework. Used for CSA STAR for AI Level 1 submissions.
relationToCloudSecurity: AI service vendors use AI-CAIQ to self-attest controls coverage for STAR Registry entries.
relationToAISecurity: Standard mechanism for AI vendors to demonstrate AICM coverage. Companion to AICM v1.1.0.

license.notes: CSA publications are typically released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Copyright notice in the v1.1.0 workbook reads © Copyright 2026 Cloud Security Alliance.

lifecycle.notes: Ships in the AICM v1.1 ZIP bundle. The questionnaire jumped 1.0.2 -> 1.1.0 to version in lockstep with AICM; there is no AI-CAIQ 1.0.3 or 1.1 preview release. Change Log sheet dates the questionnaire revision 2026/03/17 and the bundle release 2026/06/23; CSA's artifact page states 06/22/2026.

current_extraction.notes: Parsed from the standalone AI_CAIQv1.1.0-star_security_questionnaire workbook, then enriched with the full AICM v1.1.0 control record for each question. Verified against the AI-CAIQ tab embedded in the AICM workbook: identical 320 question IDs, identical question text, identical parent-control assignment.

notes: Question IDs derive from AICM control IDs, so the AICM v1.1.0 control renumbering moved question IDs too — AI-CAIQ 1.0.2 question IDs are NOT interchangeable with 1.1.0. Per-question detail is in CHANGELOG.md, with a machine-readable copy in aicm-caiq-1.1.0-changelog.json whose `id_reuse` field marks every question ID that now asks a different question — 63 of them. See ../../aicm/VERSIONING.md. Answer columns (Service Provider AI-CAIQ Answer, SSRM Control Ownership, implementation description, customer responsibilities) ship blank; they are the vendor response template and are retained as empty fields in the extraction.

desired_end_state.notes: 320 questions with full parent-control enrichment. Reproducible via ../../aicm/1.1.0/scripts/parse_caiq.py.
